recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future cleanup of dormant consentdirective files, retained OID registry entries, or broader Contract removal should proceed under a current, build-scope issue rather than this historical profile-to-resource issue.
issue_request: FHIR-7533 asked to replace ConsentDirective-as-a-profile-on-Contract with a standalone Consent-focused resource; it was Published/Persuasive with final resolution that FHIR now has Consent as a Resource.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-7533 source commit was found. Untagged history introduced Consent as a resource in acc3f3137b, documented/simplified it in ba3db96597 and 1264e32b13, and current fhir.ini records ConsentDirective became Consent while omitting consentdirective from active profiles.
additional_context: Related issues FHIR-7253 and FHIR-7871 are already audited on the combined branch and were resolved by the same Consent-resource migration. Later FHIR-19529 intentionally set the current Contract relationship text so Consent is used where it applies and references Contract when both exist. Zulip discussions in 2016 corroborate the migration from a Contract profile/IG path to a standalone Consent resource.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source change is needed because the active build already has Consent as a resource with Consent-specific modeling and examples, while the old ConsentDirective profile and PCD IG references are dormant/out of active build scope.
